# Requires curl, OpenSSL and Python 3. Export PAGSMILE_SK; the HMAC helper reads it from the environment, never command-line arguments. Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
BASE_URL="${PAGSMILE_BASE_URL:-https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br}"
REQ_PATH="/v3/med/cancel"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-30}"
case "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) echo 'PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
BODY='{"case_id":"med_case_1791792000000000000"}'

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
TS=$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 ))
NONCE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
HASH=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hex | sed 's/^.* //')
STRING_TO_SIGN=$(printf 'POST\n%s\n\ncontent-type:application/json\nx-client-id:%s\nx-content-hash:%s\nx-nonce:%s\nx-timestamp:%s\n%s\n%s\n%s' \
  "$REQ_PATH" "$PAGSMILE_AK" "$HASH" "$NONCE" "$TS" "$HASH" "$TS" "$NONCE")
SIGNATURE=$(printf '%s' "$STRING_TO_SIGN" | python3 -c 'import hashlib, hmac, os, sys; print(hmac.new(os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"].encode("utf-8"), sys.stdin.buffer.read(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest())')

curl -sS --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -X POST "$BASE_URL$REQ_PATH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: your-app/1.0" \
  -H "X-Client-ID: $PAGSMILE_AK" \
  -H "X-Timestamp: $TS" \
  -H "X-Nonce: $NONCE" \
  -H "X-Content-Hash: $HASH" \
  -H "X-Signature: $SIGNATURE" \
  --data-raw "$BODY"

# Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
import hashlib, hmac, json, os, secrets, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL", "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br")
PATH = "/v3/med/cancel"
AK, SK = os.environ["PAGSMILE_AK"], os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"]
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "30"))
if TIMEOUT_SECONDS <= 0:
    sys.exit("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")

payload = {
    "case_id": "med_case_1791792000000000000",
}
body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
ts, nonce = str(int(time.time() * 1000)), secrets.token_hex(16)
content_hash = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
string_to_sign = "\n".join([
    "POST", PATH, "",
    "content-type:application/json",
    f"x-client-id:{AK}",
    f"x-content-hash:{content_hash}",
    f"x-nonce:{nonce}",
    f"x-timestamp:{ts}",
    content_hash, ts, nonce,
])
signature = hmac.new(SK.encode(), string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

req = urllib.request.Request(BASE_URL + PATH, data=body, method="POST", headers={
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "User-Agent": "your-app/1.0",
    "X-Client-ID": AK,
    "X-Timestamp": ts,
    "X-Nonce": nonce,
    "X-Content-Hash": content_hash,
    "X-Signature": signature,
})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as resp:
        print(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
    print(err.read().decode("utf-8"))
except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as err:
    print(f"Transport failure: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

x-codeSamples.source:
// Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}
	path := "/v3/med/cancel"
	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error
		timeoutSeconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"case_id": "med_case_1791792000000000000"
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

        "X-Content-Hash: $contentHash",
        "X-Signature: $signature",

]);

    fwrite(STDERR, 'Transport failure: ' . curl_error($ch) . PHP_EOL);

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}
	path := "/v3/med/create"
	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error
		timeoutSeconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"end_to_end_id": "E12345678202611101200ABCDEF1234567",
	"original_fraud_situation": 1
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

	"strings"

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}

	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error

		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"start_date": 1791724800000,
	"end_date": 1791811200000,
	"page_size": 20
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)

	}

// Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}
	path := "/v3/med/detail"
	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error
		timeoutSeconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"case_id": "med_case_example_001"
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

}`)

	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	if err != nil {

# Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
import hashlib, hmac, json, os, secrets, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL", "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br")
PATH = "/v3/transfers/internal"
AK, SK = os.environ["PAGSMILE_AK"], os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"]
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "30"))
if TIMEOUT_SECONDS <= 0:
    sys.exit("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")

payload = {
    "payee": {
        "name": "Demo Receiver",
        "document_id": "12345678909",
        "document_type": 1,
        "bank_account": "00000002",
        "bank_account_type": 1,
        "bank_branch": "0001",
        "bank_code": "12345678",
    },
    "amount": "10.00",
    "currency": "BRL",
    "merchant_order_id": time.strftime("%y%m%d", time.gmtime()) + "-internal-001",
}
body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
ts, nonce = str(int(time.time() * 1000)), secrets.token_hex(16)
content_hash = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
string_to_sign = "\n".join([
    "POST", PATH, "",
    "content-type:application/json",
    f"x-client-id:{AK}",
    f"x-content-hash:{content_hash}",
    f"x-nonce:{nonce}",
    f"x-timestamp:{ts}",
    content_hash, ts, nonce,
])
signature = hmac.new(SK.encode(), string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

req = urllib.request.Request(BASE_URL + PATH, data=body, method="POST", headers={
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "User-Agent": "your-app/1.0",
    "X-Client-ID": AK,
    "X-Timestamp": ts,
    "X-Nonce": nonce,
    "X-Content-Hash": content_hash,
    "X-Signature": signature,
})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as resp:
        print(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
    print(err.read().decode("utf-8"))
except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as err:
    print(f"Transport failure: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

// Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}
	path := "/v3/transfers/internal"
	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error
		timeoutSeconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"payee": {
		"name": "Demo Receiver",
		"document_id": "12345678909",
		"document_type": 1,
		"bank_account": "00000002",
		"bank_account_type": 1,
		"bank_branch": "0001",
		"bank_code": "12345678"
	},
	"amount": "10.00",
	"currency": "BRL",
	"merchant_order_id": "` + time.Now().UTC().Format("060102") + `-internal-001"
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

]);

        "X-Nonce: $nonce",
        "X-Content-Hash: $contentHash",
        "X-Signature: $signature",

    exit(1);

# Requires curl, OpenSSL and Python 3. Export PAGSMILE_SK; the HMAC helper reads it from the environment, never command-line arguments. Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
BASE_URL="${PAGSMILE_BASE_URL:-https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br}"
REQ_PATH="/v3/refunds/pix"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-30}"
case "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) echo 'PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
BODY='{"original_settlement_id":"E876543212026111017000000000000001","merchant_order_id":"'"$(date -u +%y%m%d)"'-refund-001","amount":"10.50"}'

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
TS=$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 ))
NONCE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
HASH=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hex | sed 's/^.* //')
STRING_TO_SIGN=$(printf 'POST\n%s\n\ncontent-type:application/json\nx-client-id:%s\nx-content-hash:%s\nx-nonce:%s\nx-timestamp:%s\n%s\n%s\n%s' \
  "$REQ_PATH" "$PAGSMILE_AK" "$HASH" "$NONCE" "$TS" "$HASH" "$TS" "$NONCE")
SIGNATURE=$(printf '%s' "$STRING_TO_SIGN" | python3 -c 'import hashlib, hmac, os, sys; print(hmac.new(os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"].encode("utf-8"), sys.stdin.buffer.read(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest())')

curl -sS --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -X POST "$BASE_URL$REQ_PATH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: your-app/1.0" \
  -H "X-Client-ID: $PAGSMILE_AK" \
  -H "X-Timestamp: $TS" \
  -H "X-Nonce: $NONCE" \
  -H "X-Content-Hash: $HASH" \
  -H "X-Signature: $SIGNATURE" \
  --data-raw "$BODY"

// Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		baseURL = "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br"
	}
	path := "/v3/med/list"
	ak, sk := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_AK"), os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_SK")
	timeoutSeconds := 30
	if value := os.Getenv("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"); value != "" {
		var err error
		timeoutSeconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || timeoutSeconds <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(timeoutSeconds) * time.Second}

	body := []byte(`{
	"page": 1,
	"page_size": 20
}`)

	// Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
	ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
	nb := make([]byte, 16)
	rand.Read(nb)
	nonce := hex.EncodeToString(nb)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	contentHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	stringToSign := strings.Join([]string{
		"POST", path, "",
		"content-type:application/json",
		"x-client-id:" + ak,
		"x-content-hash:" + contentHash,
		"x-nonce:" + nonce,
		"x-timestamp:" + ts,
		contentHash, ts, nonce,
	}, "\n")
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(sk))
	mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
	signature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "your-app/1.0")
	req.Header.Set("X-Client-ID", ak)
	req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts)
	req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce)
	req.Header.Set("X-Content-Hash", contentHash)
	req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature)
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Transport failure:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

# Requires curl, OpenSSL and Python 3. Export PAGSMILE_SK; the HMAC helper reads it from the environment, never command-line arguments. Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
BASE_URL="${PAGSMILE_BASE_URL:-https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br}"
REQ_PATH="/v3/webhooks/update"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-30}"
case "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) echo 'PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
BODY='{"event_type":1,"callback_url":"https://merchant.example.test/webhooks","account_number":"00000001"}'

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
TS=$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 ))
NONCE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
HASH=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hex | sed 's/^.* //')
STRING_TO_SIGN=$(printf 'POST\n%s\n\ncontent-type:application/json\nx-client-id:%s\nx-content-hash:%s\nx-nonce:%s\nx-timestamp:%s\n%s\n%s\n%s' \
  "$REQ_PATH" "$PAGSMILE_AK" "$HASH" "$NONCE" "$TS" "$HASH" "$TS" "$NONCE")
SIGNATURE=$(printf '%s' "$STRING_TO_SIGN" | python3 -c 'import hashlib, hmac, os, sys; print(hmac.new(os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"].encode("utf-8"), sys.stdin.buffer.read(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest())')

curl -sS --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -X POST "$BASE_URL$REQ_PATH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: your-app/1.0" \
  -H "X-Client-ID: $PAGSMILE_AK" \
  -H "X-Timestamp: $TS" \
  -H "X-Nonce: $NONCE" \
  -H "X-Content-Hash: $HASH" \
  -H "X-Signature: $SIGNATURE" \
  --data-raw "$BODY"

# Set PAGSMILE_AK and PAGSMILE_SK. PAGSMILE_BASE_URL defaults to the Sandbox.
import hashlib, hmac, json, os, secrets, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_BASE_URL", "https://ebanking-openapi-sandbox.pagsmile.com.br")
PATH = "/v3/webhooks/update"
AK, SK = os.environ["PAGSMILE_AK"], os.environ["PAGSMILE_SK"]
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "30"))
if TIMEOUT_SECONDS <= 0:
    sys.exit("PAGSMILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer")

payload = {
    "event_type": 1,
    "callback_url": "https://merchant.example.test/webhooks",
    "account_number": "00000001",
}
body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

# Sign the exact bytes you send. Use a new nonce and timestamp on every attempt.
ts, nonce = str(int(time.time() * 1000)), secrets.token_hex(16)
content_hash = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
string_to_sign = "\n".join([
    "POST", PATH, "",
    "content-type:application/json",
    f"x-client-id:{AK}",
    f"x-content-hash:{content_hash}",
    f"x-nonce:{nonce}",
    f"x-timestamp:{ts}",
    content_hash, ts, nonce,
])
signature = hmac.new(SK.encode(), string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

req = urllib.request.Request(BASE_URL + PATH, data=body, method="POST", headers={
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "User-Agent": "your-app/1.0",
    "X-Client-ID": AK,
    "X-Timestamp": ts,
    "X-Nonce": nonce,
    "X-Content-Hash": content_hash,
    "X-Signature": signature,
})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as resp:
        print(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
    print(err.read().decode("utf-8"))
except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as err:
    print(f"Transport failure: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
