event_type.description: Event type: `1` PIX_IN, `2` PIX_OUT, `3` REFUND_IN, `4` REFUND_OUT, `5` VA_ACCOUNT_KYB, `6` MASTER_ACCOUNT_KYB. ACCOUNT and USER credentials accept `1` through `5`; PLATFORM accepts only `6`. Omission or `0` is rejected.

account_number.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; preserve leading zeros. Required for USER transaction events (`1` through `4`), but it does not limit the subscription to that account. Optional for ACCOUNT and must match its bound account when provided; omit it for USER event `5` and PLATFORM.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID, trimmed before lookup. When provided, selection uses the ID and authenticated owner, without additional application or event matching. When omitted, selection uses the owner, application and event; `event_type` and conditionally required `account_number` remain required.

webhook_id.description: ID of the deactivated subscription. The ID remains unchanged.

deleted_at.description: Time when the successful deactivation response is produced, in Unix milliseconds (UTC). This is not a stored deletion timestamp.

error.description: Current responses return `null`. Read the envelope's `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Current responses return `null`. Use the envelope's `code` to determine the result.

pix_key.description: Existing key owned by the target account. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; CNPJ-format values are uppercased. The type is inferred from the value; accepted formats appear in [Key formats](#key-formats).

deleted_at.description: Deletion update time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). If no update time is returned, the server uses its response-generation time, so this field is nonzero on success.

error.description: Always `null` in a successful deletion response. Read the envelope's `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Always `null` in a successful deletion response. There is no separate deletion status field.

amount.description: Amount in BRL as a decimal string, greater than `0`, with at most two decimal places. Do not send a JSON number.

city.description: Required city name, at most 15 ASCII characters after normalization. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, repeated whitespace is collapsed, supported accented letters are converted and text is uppercased. Unconvertible characters are rejected.

expires.description: Validity duration in seconds. Omit it or send `0` to use `7200` seconds.

payer_name.description: Required when `payer_document_id` is provided; otherwise omit both fields. Included in QR creation only when `payer_verify` is `true`, in which case the name must contain printable ASCII characters or whitespace.

payer_document_id.description: Required when `payer_name` is provided; otherwise omit both fields. Must have 11 or 14 characters; this validation checks length, not document authenticity. Included in QR creation only when `payer_verify` is `true`.

payer_verify.description: Whether to include the specified payer's information in QR creation. Information is included only when this is `true` and both payer fields are present. The paired-field rule applies even when this is `false`.

merchant_order_id.description: Order ID beginning with a valid UTC date in `YYMMDD` format, using only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. The date's day interval must overlap the current UTC time's ±1-hour window; use today's UTC date for normal calls. Reserved IDs are rejected without successful replay; see [uniqueness across accounts and operations and the 48-hour reservation](/api-reference/payin/generate-dynamic-qr-code#order-ids-and-retries).

pix_key.description: ACTIVE Pix key owned by the target account. The registered account number, holder document and document type must match that account.

pix_key_type.description: Pix key type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ, `3` EMAIL, `4` PHONE, `5` EVP. Send the type of your registered key.

memo.description: Optional note included in the QR code's additional payment information.

reuseable.description: Ignored by this endpoint. It does not control QR code reuse; omit it.

payload_base64.description: Base64-encoded Pix payment payload. The example is abbreviated and is not a payable QR code.

payload_image_base64.description: QR image field. This endpoint does not populate it and returns an empty string.

qr_code_id.description: Generated QR code identifier: an 8-digit UTC `YYMMDDHH` prefix followed by 18 hexadecimal characters. Save it unchanged to query [QR code details](/api-reference/payin/get-qr-code-details).

merchant_order_id.description: The merchant order ID supplied in your request.

error.description: Returns `null` in successful QR creation data. Business errors are reported through the envelope's `code` and `message`.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; `null` on errors. QR creation does not confirm payment or credit to the account.

merchant_order_id.description: Your order identifier, containing only ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, with a valid UTC `YYMMDD` date prefix. That UTC day must overlap the current time plus or minus one hour. Order IDs share a 48-hour duplicate check; see [Retries and duplicates](#retries-and-duplicates).

pix_key.description: Active EVP key registered to the receiving account and its holder. It must contain 32 to 36 bytes and must not contain `@`. The registered account number, holder document and document type must match the target account.

pix_key_type.description: Key type: only `5` EVP is accepted. Other key types and an omitted field are rejected.

city.description: Optional receiving city; an empty or whitespace-only string is accepted. Spaces are trimmed and collapsed, supported accented characters are converted to ASCII, and letters are uppercased. The normalized city must contain at most 15 printable ASCII characters.

memo.description: Optional note associated with the QR code.

payload_base64.description: Base64-encoded Pix payment payload. Use the resulting payload to render your QR image.

payload_image_base64.description: QR image field. This endpoint does not populate it and returns an empty string.

qr_code_id.description: Generated QR code identifier. Save it to [query QR code details](/api-reference/payin/get-qr-code-details). It is not the ID of an individual payment.

merchant_order_id.description: Order identifier supplied in your request.

error.description: Unpopulated field, returned as `null` on success. Read the envelope's `code` for errors.

GetAccountBalanceRequest.description: Send an empty JSON object (`{}`). This request has no business fields. The credential and account-target headers select the account.

GetAccountBalanceData.description: Details and balance snapshot for one account. A successful business result does not rule out partial data or zero fallbacks.

balance.description: Total account balance, as a decimal string in BRL. Can fall back to `"0"` when balance retrieval fails.

frozen_amount.description: Total blocked amount, as a decimal string in BRL. Can fall back to `"0"` when balance retrieval fails.

available_amount.description: Available balance, as a decimal string in BRL. The balance snapshot calculates it as `balance` minus `frozen_amount`; it can fall back to `"0"`.

currency.description: Balance currency. Defaults to `BRL` when the currency is unavailable or balance retrieval fails.

med_frozen_amount.description: Amount blocked for MED, as a decimal string in BRL, capped at `frozen_amount`. Falls back to `"0"` when MED information is unavailable, even if the other balances are available.

other_frozen_amount.description: Amount calculated as `frozen_amount` minus `med_frozen_amount`, with a minimum of `"0"`. If MED information is unavailable, this field can include MED blocks.

pix_keys.description: ACTIVE Pix keys from the first page of up to 99 retrieved keys. Can be empty if retrieval fails; this endpoint has no pagination controls.

limit_config.description: Available account limit configuration, or `null` when no configuration is retrieved. Missing amounts are empty strings, not zero or unlimited limits.

webhooks.description: Event subscriptions visible to the signing credential and application. ACCOUNT returns active account subscriptions; USER returns user subscriptions without filtering by the target account. Can be empty if retrieval fails.

fee_configs.description: Transaction and non-transaction fee configurations for the account. Can be `null` when unavailable; an empty array means no entries were returned.

error.description: Unused compatibility field. This query returns `null`; read the envelope `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Unused compatibility field. This query returns `null`; read the envelope `code` for the business result.

GetAccountBalancePixKey.description: One ACTIVE Pix key returned by the account query.

pix_key_type.description: Key type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ, `3` email, `4` phone, `5` random key (EVP).

status.description: Key status: `1` ACTIVE. This account query filters out other key statuses.

created_at.description: Key creation time in Unix milliseconds. Can be `0` if the creation time is unavailable.

GetAccountBalanceLimitConfig.description: Available limit configuration. Individual sections can be `null`.

withdraw.description: Withdrawal-limit view, or `null` when unavailable. It reuses the CNPJ transfer-limit amounts and does not retrieve independent withdrawal limits.

daytime.description: Daytime transfer limits, or `null` when unavailable.

nighttime.description: Nighttime transfer limits, or `null` when unavailable.

GetAccountBalanceWithdrawalLimits.description: CNPJ transfer limits shown in the withdrawal section. CPF withdrawal limits are not populated.

daytime.description: Daytime withdrawal-limit view, or `null` when unavailable.

nighttime.description: Nighttime withdrawal-limit view, or `null` when unavailable.

GetAccountBalanceTransferDay.description: Daytime transfer limits by document type.

cpf.description: Configured CPF transfer limit in BRL, as a decimal string. An empty string means unavailable.

cnpj.description: Configured CNPJ transfer limit in BRL, as a decimal string. An empty string means unavailable.

GetAccountBalanceTransferNight.description: Nighttime transfer limits by document type.

cpf.description: Configured CPF transfer limit in BRL, as a decimal string. An empty string means unavailable.

cnpj.description: Configured CNPJ transfer limit in BRL, as a decimal string. An empty string means unavailable.

nighttime_period.description: Nighttime period returned with the limit configuration. Can be empty; do not infer a schedule when it is unavailable.

cpf.description: Unpopulated compatibility field, returned as an empty string. Do not use it to determine a CPF withdrawal limit.

cnpj.description: CNPJ transfer-limit amount reused in this withdrawal view, as a decimal string in BRL.

cpf.description: Unpopulated compatibility field, returned as an empty string. Do not use it to determine a CPF withdrawal limit.

cnpj.description: CNPJ transfer-limit amount reused in this withdrawal view, as a decimal string in BRL.

nighttime_period.description: Nighttime period returned with the limit configuration. Can be empty; do not infer a schedule when it is unavailable.

GetAccountBalanceWebhook.description: Event subscription visible to the signing credential.

webhook_id.description: Event subscription ID. Use this field to identify the subscription.

event_type.description: Subscribed event name, returned as a string.

callback_url.description: URL that receives callbacks for the subscription.

status.description: Subscription status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` ACTIVE, `2` INACTIVE.

created_at.description: Subscription creation time in Unix milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time (UTC). Unix milliseconds at creation; after an update or deactivation, the stored value can be Unix seconds. Treat a nonzero value below `1000000000000` as seconds.

account_number.description: Unpopulated compatibility field, returned as an empty string. It does not identify the subscription account in this response.

subscription_id.description: Unpopulated compatibility field, returned as an empty string. Use `webhook_id` instead.

suspend_reason.description: Unpopulated compatibility field, returned as an empty string.

payment_method.description: Payment method covered by the configuration.

flow_direction.description: Funds direction covered by the configuration.

transaction_type.description: Transaction category covered by the configuration.

charge_type.description: Fee calculation method: `PERCENTAGE` or `FIXED`. `PERCENTAGE` applies `min_amount` and `max_amount` to the calculated fee; `FIXED` uses `charge_weight` without these bounds.

charge_weight.description: Fee calculation weight as a decimal string: percentage points for `PERCENTAGE`, or an amount in BRL for `FIXED`.

min_amount.description: Minimum calculated fee, as a decimal string in BRL. Applied as a floor to `PERCENTAGE` fees, not as a minimum transaction amount.

max_amount.description: Maximum calculated fee, as a decimal string in BRL. Applied as a cap to `PERCENTAGE` fees, not as a maximum transaction amount.

fee_kind.description: Fee category, returned as a string.

start_date.description: Transaction initiation time lower bound in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Required, nonzero and less than `end_date`. Positive values include the start boundary; negative values do not apply a lower time bound.

end_date.description: Transaction initiation time upper bound in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Required, nonzero and greater than `start_date`. Positive values include the end boundary, subject to the exclusive snapshot bound; negative values do not apply an end-date bound.

page_size.description: Maximum entries per page. Defaults to `20` when omitted; send an integer from `1` to `100`.

txn_id.description: Filter by the entry's transaction ID. For a refund or dispute, use that entry's ID, not the original payment ID. Omit it or send an empty string for no ID filter.

settlement_id.description: Filter by the entry's settlement identifier. Omit it or send an empty string for no settlement-ID filter.

funds_type.description: Direction filter: `0` UNSPECIFIED (both directions), `1` CREDIT (target account is the payee), `2` DEBIT (target account is the payer). Incoming entries require a completed underlying transaction; outgoing entries can have other statuses. Other integers currently behave like `0`; use the documented values.

transaction_type.description: Type filter: `0` UNSPECIFIED (payments, refunds and disputes), `1` PAYMENT, `2` REFUND, `6` DISPUTE. Other values are rejected with `code` equal to `400` and message `txn_type is invalid`.

snapshot_timestamp.description: Exclusive upper bound on transaction initiation time, in Unix milliseconds. Omitted, zero or negative values use the current server time. Reuse the returned bound on subsequent pages; it does not freeze entry contents or guarantee snapshot isolation.

cursor.description: Omit for the first page. On subsequent pages, send the returned cursor unchanged with the same account, filters and snapshot. A cursor is ignored unless `timestamp` is positive and `id` is nonempty.

timestamp.description: Cursor initiation time in Unix milliseconds. Must be positive for the cursor to take effect; use together with `id`.

id.description: Cursor transaction ID. Must be nonempty for the cursor to take effect; use the returned ID together with `timestamp`.

direction.description: Pagination direction: `0` UNSPECIFIED (forward), `1` FORWARD, `2` BACKWARD. Only `2` selects backward pagination; other integers currently use forward pagination. The response provides the next forward cursor, not a separate previous-page cursor.

statements.description: Matching entries, ordered by transaction initiation time descending, then transaction ID descending. An empty array means no entries matched this page.

snapshot_timestamp.description: Effective exclusive time upper bound in Unix milliseconds. Reuse it for the next page; it is not an immutable snapshot of transaction statuses.

cursor.description: Next forward cursor. In a forward scan, `null` means no further page is available.

page.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Use `cursor`, not page numbers or totals.

error.description: Unused in successful statement data. Read the envelope's `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Unused in successful statement data. Read each entry's `txn_status` for its transaction result.

timestamp.description: Initiation time of the cursor entry in Unix milliseconds. Send it together with the returned `id`.

id.description: Transaction ID of the cursor entry. Keep it unchanged when continuing the scan.

direction.description: Direction enum: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` FORWARD, `2` BACKWARD. This endpoint returns `1` for the next-page cursor.

txn_id.description: ID of this payment, refund or dispute entry. Match the intended transaction; the first entry is only the newest matching entry.

amount.description: Transaction amount as a decimal string in BRL. The amount is not negated for debits; use direction and participant account details rather than the amount's sign.

created_at.description: Transaction initiation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC), despite the field name. It is not the record creation time. A missing initiation time is represented as `0`.

settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier, when available. For TED, it stays empty until settlement is complete. An empty identifier alone does not prove failure.

payment_method.description: Payment method: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PIX, `2` CARD, `3` TED, `4` BOLETO, `5` BOOK. An enum value does not imply that every method is enabled for your account.

payment_variant.description: Payment variant: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PIX_MANUAL, `2` PIX_KEY, `3` STATIC_QRCODE, `4` DYNAMIC_QRCODE, `5` AUTO_PIX, `6` TED_MANUAL, `7` BOOK_MANUAL, `8` BOLETO, `9` DYNAMIC_BILLING, `10` DYNAMIC_BOLETO.

is_credit.description: True when the payee's document number matches the authenticated entity's document number. This is a document match, not an account-number comparison. For transfers between accounts sharing a document, compare `payer` and `payee` account details with the target account.

txn_status.description: Transaction status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PENDING, `2` COMPLETED, `3` FAILED, `4` CANCELLED, `5` PROCESSING, `6` REFUNDED, `7` PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, `8` DISPUTED. PAYMENT entries use the displayed payment status. DISPUTE entries map pending and processing to `5`, completed to `2`, and failed to `3`.

payee.description: Payee details for this entry, when available.

payer.description: Payer details for this entry, when available.

txn_type.description: Transaction type enum: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PAYMENT, `2` REFUND, `3` TRANSFER, `4` WITHDRAWAL, `5` DEPOSIT, `6` DISPUTE. This query returns PAYMENT, REFUND and DISPUTE entries; the remaining values belong to the shared enum.

parent_txn_id.description: Original payment ID linked to a refund or dispute. Empty for payment entries.

parent_settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier of the linked original payment, when available. Empty for payment entries.

document_id.description: Participant document number. It may be masked according to your document-masking configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT, `5` TRANSCTIONAL_PI, `6` GUARANTEED, `7` DEPOSIT.

account_number.description: Target account number: 1 to 32 digits. Preserve leading zeros; it must match the account selected by your credential and account-target headers.

operation_id.description: Operation ID from `data.operation.operation_id` in the original closure response. It must contain a non-whitespace character, be at most 64 bytes, and belong to the target account.

code.description: Reason code. Examples include `NON_ZERO_BALANCE`, `FROZEN_BALANCE`, `ACTIVE_PIX_KEYS`, `OPEN_CHILD_ACCOUNTS`, `OPEN_MED_CASE`, `OPEN_INFRACTION`, `UNPAID_BILL` and `PENDING_PAYMENT`. Read it with `kind` and `message`; the list is not exhaustive.

message.description: Description of the condition or processing problem.
message.example: Account balance must be exactly zero before closure

step.description: Processing step that produced the reason.

kind.description: Reason category: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` WAITING, `2` BLOCKING, `3` RETRYABLE, `4` MANUAL. A MANUAL reason requires operations review.

count.description: Associated-record count when supplied. Balance reasons use `1` as an indicator; other reasons can use `0` without passing the check.

references.description: Associated record IDs, when supplied. Current checks do not populate IDs and return `null`; do not use this field to enumerate obligations.

operation.description: Existing closure operation and current progress.

operation_id.description: Persistent closure operation ID. Keep it for progress queries.

account_number.description: Target account number, including leading zeros.

account_status.description: Bank account status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` ACTIVE, `2` INACTIVE, `3` BLOCKED, `4` CLOSED. Read it separately from the closure operation status.

status.description: Closure status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CHECKING, `2` WAITING, `3` DELETING_KEYS, `4` CLOSED, `5` COMPLETED, `6` REJECTED. CLOSED means the account is closed but cleanup can remain; COMPLETED means cleanup also finished.

current_step.description: Current processing step, not a progress percentage. Completed operations use `DONE`.

reasons.description: Eligibility or processing reasons. An empty list alone does not prove completion. Can be `null` right after submission; treat `null` as an empty list.

updated_at.description: Last operation update in Unix milliseconds (UTC).

checked_at.description: Last eligibility check in Unix milliseconds (UTC). `0` means no check time has been recorded.

next_action.description: Recommended action: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` WAIT_SYSTEM, `2` RESOLVE_AND_REAPPLY, `3` CONTACT_OPERATIONS, `4` NONE. A MANUAL reason takes precedence; otherwise REJECTED returns `2`, COMPLETED returns `4`, and processing returns `1`.

next_retry_at.description: Next server processing time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). `0` means no retry is scheduled and does not prove completion.

closed_at.description: Account closure time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). `0` means closure has not been recorded.

completed_at.description: Cleanup completion time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). `0` means completion has not been recorded.

event_type.description: Event type: `1` PIX_IN, `2` PIX_OUT, `3` REFUND_IN, `4` REFUND_OUT, `5` VA_ACCOUNT_KYB, `6` MASTER_ACCOUNT_KYB. ACCOUNT and USER credentials accept `1` through `5`; PLATFORM accepts only `6`. Omission or `0` is rejected.

account_number.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; preserve leading zeros. Required for USER transaction events (`1` through `4`), but it does not limit the subscription to that account. Optional for ACCOUNT and must match its bound account when provided; omit it for USER event `5` and PLATFORM.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID, trimmed before lookup. When provided, selection uses the ID and authenticated owner, without additional application or event matching. When omitted, selection uses the owner, application and event; `event_type` and conditionally required `account_number` remain required.

webhook_id.description: Subscription ID to use as `subscription_id` in later requests.

event_type.description: Subscribed event name as a string. Request values `1` through `6` correspond to `PIX_PAYMENT_IN`, `PIX_PAYMENT_OUT`, `PIX_REFUND_IN`, `PIX_REFUND_OUT`, `VA_ACCOUNT_KYB` and `MASTER_ACCOUNT_KYB`. ID-based selection can return other event names.

status.description: Subscription status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` ACTIVE, `2` INACTIVE. This describes the configuration, not callback delivery or transaction completion.

created_at.description: Original creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Zero does not indicate pending creation.

updated_at.description: Last update time (UTC). Unix milliseconds at creation; after an update or deactivation, the stored value can be Unix seconds. Treat a nonzero value below `1000000000000` as seconds.

account_number.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Do not use it to determine the subscription scope.

subscription_id.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Use `webhook_id` as the subscription ID.

suspend_reason.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Read `status` to check activation.

error.description: Current responses return `null`. Read the envelope's `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Current responses return `null`. Use the envelope's `code` to determine the result.

document.description: Participant document number as returned. Do not assume it is masked; apply your own display and storage controls.

bank_name.description: Bank name for the participant account.

ispb.description: ISPB of the institution holding the participant account.

root_end_to_end_id.description: End-to-end ID of the original Pix transaction.

amount.description: Original transaction amount, as a decimal string in BRL.

currency.description: Currency code of the original transaction.

completed_at.description: Original transaction completion time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

payer.description: Original payer information, or `null` when unavailable.

payee.description: Original payee information, or `null` when unavailable.

infraction_id.description: Infraction task ID. Pass this exact ID to the details endpoint; it differs from `infraction_report_id`.

account.description: Account number associated with the report.

status.description: Recorded infraction task stage: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` RECEIVED, `2` BLOCKING_PENDING, `3` BLOCKED, `4` ANALYSIS_PENDING, `5` CLOSED_AGREED, `6` CLOSED_DISAGREED, `7` CANCELLED, `8` FAILED. Task closure does not establish frozen funds or a completed return; read `freeze_status` and amounts separately. See [Task statuses](/api-reference/med/get-infraction-report-details#task-statuses) for meanings and verification steps.

status_display.description: Status display text. Use `status` for decisions.

amount.description: Amount requested in the report, not necessarily the original, blocked or returned amount, as a decimal string in BRL.

created_time.description: Infraction task creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

updated_time.description: Infraction task last update time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

infraction_report_id.description: Infraction report business ID, distinct from the task ID.

root_end_to_end_id.description: End-to-end ID of the original Pix transaction.

blocked_amount.description: Blocked amount recorded for the task, as a decimal string in BRL.

dict_infraction_report_id.description: Infraction report ID in DICT. Not the ID accepted by this endpoint.

freeze_reference_id.description: Funds freeze reference ID associated with this task.

freeze_target_amount.description: Target amount for the funds freeze, as a decimal string in BRL.

freeze_effective_amount.description: Effective frozen amount, as a decimal string in BRL.

freeze_shortfall_amount.description: Shortfall against the target frozen amount, as a decimal string in BRL.

freeze_status.description: Funds freeze status text. Interpret it separately from the infraction task `status`; it can be empty before being recorded.

original_transaction.description: Original transaction information, or `null` when unavailable.

infraction_id.description: Infraction task ID from `data.items[].infraction_id` in [List infraction reports](/api-reference/med/list-infraction-reports). Do not use a report business ID or DICT report ID.

infraction.description: Details for the selected receiving account.

error.description: Unused on a successful response. Business errors use the outer envelope.

result.description: Unused on a successful response. Read the outer `code`.

GetManagedAccountRequest.description: Send either a non-empty `reference_id` or an `account` object containing both identifiers. Do not send both selectors.

reference_id.description: Reference ID supplied when creating the account. Required when `account` is omitted; leading and trailing whitespace is removed. No UUID format is required.

account.description: Bank account selector. Required when you do not supply a non-empty `reference_id`; both identifiers must be non-empty after trimming.

ispb.description: Bank participant identifier. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before lookup.

account_number.description: Account number. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; preserve leading zeros.
Account number, with leading zeros preserved.

reference_id.description: Reference ID supplied when creating the managed account.

account_holder_document.description: Account holder's CPF or CNPJ from compliance information. Empty when unavailable.

account_holder_name.description: Account holder's legal name from compliance information. Empty when unavailable.

document_type.description: Document type: `CPF` or `CNPJ`. Empty when compliance information is unavailable or its document type is unspecified or unsupported.

model.description: Account model: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` MOR, `2` VA, `3` PA.

status.description: Account status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PENDING, `2` ACTIVE, `3` FROZEN, `4` CLOSED, `5` REJECTED, `6` EXPIRED, `7` PENDING_SUBMISSION. This endpoint does not emit `7`; unmapped statuses return `0`. Check `compliance_status` separately.

compliance_status.description: Compliance status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PENDING, `2` PENDING_SUBMISSION, `3` APPROVED, `4` REJECTED, `5` EXPIRED, `6` CREATION_FAILED, `7` REVIEWING, `8` ERROR, `9` FORCE_APPROVED. This status is separate from account activation.

compliance_session_id.description: Linked compliance process ID. Empty when no process is linked.

created_at.description: Creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Can be `0` when unavailable.

updated_at.description: Last update time as a Unix epoch value (UTC). `0` means unavailable. Otherwise the unit is not normalized: values below `1000000000000` are seconds and larger values are milliseconds.

activated_at.description: Compliance approval time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). `0` when no approval time is available; not a separate compliance-status update timestamp.

account.description: The managed account's own bank account details. `null` when either bank account identifier is unavailable.

linked_account.description: PA's direct parent bank account, which can be a master account or VA. `null` for MOR and VA.

error.description: Always `null` on a successful query. Use the envelope's `code` and `message` to handle errors.

result.description: Always `null` on a successful query. Use the envelope's `code` and `message` to interpret the result.

document.description: Participant document number as returned. Do not assume it is masked; apply your own display and storage controls.

bank_name.description: Bank name for the participant account.

ispb.description: ISPB of the institution holding the participant account.

root_end_to_end_id.description: End-to-end ID of the original Pix transaction.

amount.description: Original transaction amount, as a decimal string in BRL.

currency.description: Currency code of the original transaction.

completed_at.description: Original transaction completion time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

payer.description: Original payer information, or `null` when unavailable.

payee.description: Original payee information, or `null` when unavailable.

event_type.description: Case timeline event type, not a webhook subscription event type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CASE_CREATED, `2` CASE_TRACKED, `3` ANALYSIS_AWAITING, `4` ANALYZED, `5` REFUND_TRIGGERED, `6` REFUND_UPDATED, `7` CASE_COMPLETED, `8` CASE_CANCELLED, `9` INFRACTION_RECEIVED, `10` INFRACTION_CLOSED, `11` REFUND_REQUEST_RECEIVED, `12` REFUND_REQUEST_CLOSED, `13` SLA_BREACHED.

event_time.description: Timeline event occurrence time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

root_end_to_end_id.description: End-to-end ID of the original Pix transaction.

status.description: Recorded case stage: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CREATED, `2` TRACKED, `3` AWAITING_ANALYSIS, `4` ANALYZED, `5` RETURN_PROCESSING, `6` COMPLETED, `7` CANCELLED, `8` FAILED. `6` (COMPLETED) records workflow closure, not full recovery or account credit. See [Case statuses](/api-reference/med/get-med-case-details#case-statuses) for meanings and verification steps.

status_display.description: Status display text. Use `status` for decisions.

progress_step.description: Current workflow step, not a completion percentage. CREATED through CANCELLED map to `1` through `7`; other statuses return `0`.

original_transaction.description: Original transaction snapshot, or `null` when unavailable.

fraud_type.description: Fraud situation recorded when opening the case: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` SCAM, `2` ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER, `3` COERCION, `4` SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, `5` OTHER, `6` UNKNOWN.

requested_amount.description: Amount requested for recovery, as a decimal string in BRL.

blocked_amount_total.description: Total blocked amount recorded for the case, as a decimal string in BRL.

returned_amount_total.description: Total returned amount recorded for the case, as a decimal string in BRL. Reconcile actual credits separately.

automatic_refund.description: Whether refund submission after analysis is automatic.

created_at.description: Case creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

updated_at.description: Case last update time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

analysis_deadline.description: Analysis-related timestamp in Unix milliseconds (UTC): the analysis deadline for successfully refreshed progress, or `0` when unavailable. After cancellation, it can retain the original creation time if progress refresh fails. Do not schedule analysis from this field alone.

manual_refund_deadline.description: Manual refund deadline in Unix milliseconds (UTC). It can be `0` when unavailable.

can_cancel.description: Whether cancellation is currently allowed. It is `true` for CREATED (`1`), TRACKED (`2`), AWAITING_ANALYSIS (`3`) and ANALYZED (`4`); otherwise `false`.

timeline.description: Visible case timeline. Empty when the case has linked infraction tasks, refund tasks or funds disposition records. An empty array does not prove inactivity.

infractions.description: Always `[]` in this payer-facing response. Linked receiver-side tasks are not exposed.

refunds.description: Always `[]` in this payer-facing response. Linked receiver-side refund tasks are not exposed.

fund_dispositions.description: Always `[]` in this payer-facing response. Individual funds disposition records are not exposed.

case_id.description: MED case ID from `data.items[].case_id` in [List MED cases](/api-reference/med/list-med-cases).

error.description: Unused on a successful response. Business errors use the outer envelope.

result.description: Unused on a successful response. Read the outer `code`.

GetPaymentDetailsRequest.description: Provide a nonempty `txn_id` or `settlement_id`. `merchant_order_id` alone is not sufficient.

txn_id.description: Required when `settlement_id` is empty or omitted. Use `data.txn_id` from the payment submission response, or the statement entry matching your payment. If both identifiers are nonempty, this one takes precedence without checking `settlement_id` or using it as a fallback.

settlement_id.description: Required when `txn_id` is empty or omitted. Settlement identifier of the payment. Ignored when `txn_id` is nonempty.

merchant_order_id.description: Optional order identifier from your payment submission. If the identifier lookup finds no transaction, a matching pending order can return limited details. The order must belong to the target payer account.

document_id.description: Participant's document number. It can be masked according to your account configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` DOCUMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CPF, `2` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_CHECKING, `2` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SALARY, `3` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SAVINGS, `4` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_PAYMENT. Other account types return `0` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED in this endpoint.

payee.description: Payee details. `null` in a limited pending-order response.

payer.description: Payer details. `null` in a limited pending-order response.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID. Returned even in a limited pending-order response.

settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier. Empty for TED until settlement completes, and in a limited pending-order response.

merchant_order_id.description: Order identifier supplied when you submitted the payment.

txn_status.description: Display status: `0` TXN_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED, `1` TXN_STATUS_PENDING, `2` TXN_STATUS_COMPLETED, `3` TXN_STATUS_FAILED, `4` TXN_STATUS_CANCELLED, `5` TXN_STATUS_PROCESSING, `6` TXN_STATUS_REFUNDED, `7` TXN_STATUS_PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, `8` TXN_STATUS_DISPUTED. Unlike the status-check endpoint, this field includes refund and dispute display statuses.

source_type.description: Source: `0` SOURCE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` SOURCE_TYPE_APP, `2` SOURCE_TYPE_API, `3` SOURCE_TYPE_SCHEDULE, `4` SOURCE_TYPE_BATCH. A limited pending-order response returns `2`.

amount.description: Payment amount as a decimal string in BRL. Empty in a limited pending-order response; an empty string is not a zero amount.

memo.description: Payment note. Empty in a limited pending-order response.

credit_fee.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Returns an empty string, which does not prove the credit-side fee is zero.

debit_fee.description: Debit-side fee as a decimal string in BRL. Empty in a limited pending-order response.

currency.description: Payment currency. Empty in a limited pending-order response.

rejection_reason.description: Payment rejection or failure reason, when available. Empty in a limited pending-order response.

created_at.description: Creation time field in Unix milliseconds. This endpoint does not populate it and returns `0`; do not use it as evidence of timing.

completed_at.description: Completion time field in Unix milliseconds. This endpoint does not populate it and returns `0`, even for completed payments.

pix_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Returns `null`, including for Pix payments.

ted_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Returns `null`, including for TED payments.

original_settlement_id.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Returns an empty string.

details.description: Payment details, or limited details for a matching pending order.

error.description: Always `null` in a successful response; use the envelope's `code` for errors.

result.description: Always `null` in a successful response; use `details.txn_status` to interpret the payment.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID from `data.txn_id` in the payment submission response. If you use a statement, select the entry matching the payment, not the first entry.

txn_status.description: Recorded status: `0` TXN_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED, `1` TXN_STATUS_PENDING, `2` TXN_STATUS_COMPLETED, `3` TXN_STATUS_FAILED, `4` TXN_STATUS_CANCELLED, `5` TXN_STATUS_PROCESSING. Only `2`, `3` and `4` are final payment statuses; refund and dispute display statuses are not returned here.

error.description: Always `null` in a successful response; use the envelope's `code` for errors.

result.description: Always `null` in a successful response; use `txn_status` to track the payment.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; `null` on errors. A failed processing update can still return the latest recorded status.

qr_code_id.description: Identifier returned in `data.qr_code_id` by static or dynamic QR code generation. Use it unchanged, without surrounding whitespace. It has a valid UTC `YYMMDDHH` date-and-hour prefix and 17 or 18 hexadecimal characters; this endpoint does not accept an order ID instead.

merchant_order_id.description: Order identifier associated with QR code creation. It is not the ID of an individual payment.

is_paid.description: True only when the recorded QR payment status is COMPLETED and a matching transaction is available in `last_txn`. False does not prove that no payment occurred. For a reusable QR code, this indicator does not count payments or total their amounts.

qr_code_type.description: QR code type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` NOT_SET, `11` STATIC, `12` DYNAMIC_INSTANT_PAYMENT, `13` DYNAMIC_EXPIRE_PAYMENT, `14` COMPOSITE_PAYMENT. This is a type, not a payment status.

last_txn.description: Latest completed transaction, ordered by initiation time, whose payee matches the selected account. Returned only when the recorded QR payment status is COMPLETED; otherwise it can be `null`. The lookup covers initiation times from 24 hours before the UTC creation hour encoded in `qr_code_id` through the current time.

qr_code_memo.description: Note associated with the QR code.

qr_code_payload_base64.description: Base64-encoded Pix payment payload associated with the QR code.

created_at.description: QR code creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). A response with no QR details can contain `0`.

error.description: Unpopulated field, returned as `null` on success. Read the envelope's `code` for errors.

result.description: Unpopulated field, returned as `null` on success.

payee.description: Receiving participant details.

payer.description: Paying participant details.

txn_id.description: Individual transaction identifier. Use it to query [incoming payment details](/api-reference/payin/get-transaction-details).

settlement_id.description: Settlement transaction identifier returned for this payment.

merchant_order_id.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as an empty string. Use the QR-level `merchant_order_id` for the QR creation reference.

txn_status.description: Transaction status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PENDING, `2` COMPLETED, `3` FAILED, `4` CANCELLED, `5` PROCESSING, `6` REFUNDED, `7` PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, `8` DISPUTED. Read it separately from the QR code's `is_paid` indicator.

source_type.description: Not populated by this endpoint; `0` UNSPECIFIED.

amount.description: Amount of this individual payment as a decimal string in BRL. It is not the total amount received through a reusable QR code.

memo.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as an empty string.

credit_fee.description: Credit-side fee field, not populated here. An empty string does not mean a zero fee.

debit_fee.description: Debit-side fee field, not populated here. An empty string does not mean a zero fee.

rejection_reason.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as an empty string.

created_at.description: Transaction creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC), as returned for the associated payment.

completed_at.description: Transaction completion time in Unix milliseconds (UTC), as returned for the associated payment.

pix_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as `null`.

ted_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as `null`.

original_settlement_id.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returned as an empty string.

document_id.description: Participant document number. It can be masked according to your document-masking configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Bank account type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT, `5` TRANSCTIONAL_PI, `6` GUARANTEED, `7` DEPOSIT.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; `null` on errors. A success response without QR details contains empty strings, `false`, `0` and `null` fields.

refund_id.description: Refund ID from the initiation response or the matching refund statement entry. Required when `settlement_refund_id` is empty. Takes precedence when both identifiers are nonempty.

settlement_refund_id.description: Settlement refund ID from the initiation response or the matching refund statement entry. Required when `refund_id` is empty. Not used as a fallback or cross-check when a nonempty `refund_id` is sent.

GetRefundDetailsRequest.description: Send at least one nonempty identifier.

document_id.description: CPF or CNPJ. May be masked according to your document-masking configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` DOCUMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CPF, `2` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_CHECKING, `2` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SALARY, `3` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SAVINGS, `4` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_PAYMENT. Other account types map to `0` here.

payee.description: Refund recipient, the original payer.

payer.description: Refund sender, the original payee.

txn_id.description: Refund ID, not the original payment ID.

settlement_id.description: Not populated here; returns an empty string. Use the saved settlement refund ID.

merchant_order_id.description: Refund order ID supplied by you.

txn_status.description: Refund status: `0` TXN_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED, `1` TXN_STATUS_PENDING, `2` TXN_STATUS_COMPLETED, `3` TXN_STATUS_FAILED, `5` TXN_STATUS_PROCESSING. A completed partial refund also uses `2`.

source_type.description: Not populated here; returns `0` SOURCE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, including for API-initiated refunds.

amount.description: Refund amount as a decimal string in BRL.

credit_fee.description: Credit-side fee as a decimal string in BRL.

debit_fee.description: Debit-side fee as a decimal string in BRL.

rejection_reason.description: Not populated here; returns an empty string even for a failed refund.

created_at.description: Not populated here; returns `0`, not the refund creation time.

completed_at.description: Not populated here; returns `0`, even after completion.

pix_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

ted_details.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

original_settlement_id.description: Not populated here; returns an empty string. Use the original settlement ID you saved or matching statement parent identifiers.

details.description: Refund details for an authorized participant. The recipient can only see completed refunds.

error.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

result.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

refund_id.description: Nonempty refund ID returned by initiation. Query the same refund after a temporary error; do not initiate another refund.

refund_status.description: Refund status: `0` TXN_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED, `1` TXN_STATUS_PENDING, `2` TXN_STATUS_COMPLETED, `3` TXN_STATUS_FAILED, `5` TXN_STATUS_PROCESSING. A completed partial refund also uses `2`. A sender-side query attempts to refresh non-terminal status. For the recipient, every non-completed refund returns `5`, including failed refunds.

error.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

result.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

GetTransactionDetailsRequest.description: Provide at least one nonempty identifier. `txn_id` takes precedence when both are sent.

txn_id.description: Transaction identifier. Required when `settlement_id` is empty or omitted. Takes precedence without cross-checking or falling back to `settlement_id`.

settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier. Required when `txn_id` is empty or omitted. Used only when `txn_id` is empty.

document_id.description: CPF or CNPJ. It can be masked according to your document-masking configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT, `5` TRANSCTIONAL_PI, `6` GUARANTEED, `7` DEPOSIT.

payee.description: Payee details. Match these to your receiving account before confirming receipt.

payer.description: Payer details.

txn_id.description: Transaction identifier.

settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier. The callback names this field `settlement_txn_id`.

merchant_order_id.description: Order identifier from the associated QR code. Empty when no associated QR-code order reference is available.

txn_status.description: Display status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PENDING, `2` COMPLETED, `3` FAILED, `4` CANCELLED, `5` PROCESSING, `6` REFUNDED, `7` PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, `8` DISPUTED. Details require a completed transaction record; the displayed status can later reflect a refund or dispute.

source_type.description: Source type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` APP, `2` API, `3` SCHEDULE, `4` BATCH.

amount.description: Payment amount as a decimal string in BRL.

credit_fee.description: Credit-side fee as a decimal string in BRL.

debit_fee.description: Not populated by this endpoint; an empty string.

rejection_reason.description: Not populated by this endpoint; an empty string.

created_at.description: Not populated by this endpoint; `0`. Use the callback for the transaction timestamp.

completed_at.description: Not populated by this endpoint; `0`. It does not mean the payment is incomplete.

original_settlement_id.description: Not populated by this endpoint; an empty string.

error.description: Not populated on a successful lookup; `null`.

result.description: Not populated on a successful lookup; `null`.

pix_key.description: Registered Pix key. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and CNPJ letters are uppercased. Accepts CPF (11 digits), CNPJ (12 letters or digits followed by 2 digits), phone (`^\+55\d{10,11}$`), email (`^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$`) or EVP UUID (versions 1–5 with a valid variant).

amount.description: Optional amount in BRL. A supplied amount is trimmed, must be positive and exactly representable with two decimal places; trailing fractional zeros are accepted. Omitted, empty or whitespace-only strings skip the balance check; otherwise the available balance is checked and confirmation must use the same numeric amount.

name.description: Payee name returned by the key lookup.

document_id.description: Payee document number. It can be masked according to your configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` DOCUMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CPF, `2` DOCUMENT_TYPE_CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, `1` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_CHECKING, `2` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SALARY, `3` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_SAVINGS, `4` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_PAYMENT, `5` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_TRANSCTIONAL_PI, `6` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_GUARANTEED, `7` BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE_DEPOSIT.

bank_name.description: Payee bank name. An empty string means no bank name was obtained.

ref_id.description: Initialization reference, valid for one minute. Pass it unchanged to [Confirm Pix key payment](/api-reference/payout/pix/confirm-pix-key-payment) using the same payer account.

payee.description: Payee details to review before confirming the payment.

settlement_id.description: Planned Pix settlement identifier returned by the key lookup. It does not prove payment completion and is carried forward without being sent in the confirmation body.

error.description: Not populated in a successful initialization response. Business errors use the envelope's `code` and `message`.

result.description: Not populated in a successful initialization response.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; `null` on errors. Initialization does not submit a payment.

qr_code_payload.description: Complete Pix payment text encoded with standard Base64, including required padding. Static, dynamic instant-payment and due-date QR codes are supported; composite QR codes are not.

pix_key.description: Pix key associated with the QR code.

pix_key_type.description: Key type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ, `3` email, `4` phone, `5` EVP.

payee.description: Payee details resolved from the Pix key.

qr_code_id.description: QR code identifier returned by initialization.

expires.description: QR code expiration metadata. This is separate from the five-minute `ref_id` lifetime; do not calculate remaining validity from it.

amount.description: QR code amount in BRL, as a decimal string. May be empty or zero when no amount is specified. For due-date QR codes, this is the calculated final amount.

settlement_id.description: Settlement identifier allocated during initialization. It does not prove that a payment has settled.

qr_code_type.description: QR code type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` NOT_SET, `11` STATIC, `12` DYNAMIC_INSTANT_PAYMENT, `13` DYNAMIC_EXPIRE_PAYMENT, `14` COMPOSITE_PAYMENT. This endpoint accepts types `11`, `12` and `13`.

currency.description: Currency metadata: `BRL` for dynamic QR codes; an empty string for static QR codes. Confirmation submits the payment in BRL.

ref_id.description: Initialization reference. Pass it unchanged to confirmation within five minutes, using the same payer account.

qr_code_status.description: QR status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` ACTIVE, `2` COMPLETED, `3` PAYEE_REMOVED, `4` PSP_REMOVED. This endpoint leaves the field `0` despite checking that the QR code is active. It does not prove payment completion.

memo.description: Note supplied by the QR code, when available.

amount_editable.description: Returns `false` because this field is not populated. Do not use it to determine whether you can change the amount.

qr_code_issuance.description: Issuance mode: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` PER_TRANSACTION, `2` SHARED. This endpoint leaves the field `0`; do not use it to determine QR code reuse.

merchant_city.description: Returns an empty string because this field is not populated.

merchant_name.description: Returns an empty string because this field is not populated. Use `data.payee.name` for the payee name.

dynamic_due_properties.description: Due-date QR code details when supplied. `null` for other QR code types.

error.description: Not populated in a successful initialization response. Read the envelope `code` for business errors.

result.description: Not populated in this response.

document_id.description: Payee document number. It may be masked according to your configuration.

document_type.description: Document type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT, `5` TRANSCTIONAL_PI, `6` GUARANTEED, `7` DEPOSIT.

bank_name.description: Payee bank name. May be empty when unavailable.

face_amount.description: Original amount in BRL before adjustments, as a decimal string. Use `data.amount` for the calculated payable amount.

reduction.description: Reduction amount in BRL, as a decimal string.

discount.description: Discount amount in BRL, as a decimal string.

interest.description: Interest amount in BRL, as a decimal string.

fine.description: Fine amount in BRL, as a decimal string.

payee_street.description: Payee street address supplied in the due-date QR code.

payee_city.description: Payee city supplied in the due-date QR code.

payee_state.description: Payee state supplied in the due-date QR code.

payee_postal_code.description: Payee postal code supplied in the due-date QR code.

payee.description: Payee identity and bank account details. The payer comes from the authenticated account context.

amount.description: Payment amount in BRL as a decimal string, greater than zero and exactly representable with two decimal places. Extra trailing zeros do not add precision, so `10.000` is accepted but `10.555` is rejected. The amount must exceed the payee's total fee, so the credited amount remains positive.

currency.description: Accepted but ignored. This endpoint processes the payment in BRL even if you omit this field.

merchant_order_id.description: Required order ID: ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, beginning with a valid `YYMMDD` UTC date. That date's day must overlap the current UTC time's ±1-hour window. Use an ID unique across accounts and operations; retained IDs trigger `4001013` rather than replaying the original response.

document_id.description: Payee document number, consistent with `document_type` and the receiving account holder.

document_type.description: Required document type: `1` CPF, `2` CNPJ. Omission and `0` (UNSPECIFIED) are rejected.

bank_account.description: Payee account number, using digits only and preserving leading zeros. It must identify an active internal account different from the payer account.

bank_account_type.description: Required account type: `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT. Omission, `0` (UNSPECIFIED) and other types are rejected.

bank_branch.description: Payee branch code, using digits only. Branch codes shorter than four characters are left-padded with zeros when checking the receiving account.

bank_code.description: Payee bank ISPB. Whitespace is removed and shorter codes are padded with leading zeros; the normalized code must contain eight digits. It must match the payer account's ISPB.

bank_name.description: Accepted but ignored. The payee bank is identified by `bank_code`.

InitiateInternalTransferPayee.description: The receiving account must be active, enabled to receive payments and have no closure in progress. Its banking and holder document details must match the request.

merchant_order_id.description: Order ID supplied in the request.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID. Save it and use it as `txn_id` in [Get payment status](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-status).

txn_status.description: Submission status: `5` PROCESSING. This confirms asynchronous acceptance, not completion; query the original transfer for its final outcome.

payee.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Retrieve participant information through [Get payment details](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-details).

payer.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Retrieve participant information through [Get payment details](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-details).

error.description: Null in the accepted response. Business errors use the root `code` and `message` fields with `data` set to null.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; null on errors.

original_settlement_id.description: Settlement ID of the original completed Pix payment. Use the matching payment; do not automatically select the first statement entry.

merchant_order_id.description: Your unique refund order ID using only ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Begin with a valid `YYMMDD` UTC date whose day overlaps the current UTC time window of ±1 hour. Duplicate IDs are rejected, not replayed.

amount.description: Refund amount in BRL. Must be greater than zero, exactly representable with two decimal places, and no greater than the remaining returnable amount. Trailing decimal zeros are accepted.

reason.description: Optional explanatory text. It does not select a Pix reason code: this endpoint uses `MD06` for a payee-request refund. Omission leaves the text empty.

refund_id.description: Refund ID. Save it for details and status queries.

settlement_refund_id.description: Settlement refund ID. Save it for reconciliation and details queries.

merchant_order_id.description: Not populated in this response; returns an empty string. Keep the order ID you submitted.

txn_status.description: An accepted refund returns `1` TXN_STATUS_PENDING. Processing is asynchronous; this does not prove funds were returned.

error.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

result.description: Not populated by this endpoint; returns `null`.

payee.description: Payee identity and bank account details. The payer comes from the authenticated account context.

amount.description: Payment amount in BRL as a decimal string, greater than zero and exactly representable with two decimal places. Extra trailing zeros do not add precision, so `10.000` is accepted but `10.555` is rejected.

currency.description: Accepted but ignored. This endpoint processes the payment in BRL even if you omit this field.

memo.description: Optional payment note. Decomposable Latin accents are removed; only printable ASCII characters are accepted, without line breaks or other control characters.

merchant_order_id.description: Required order ID: ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, beginning with a valid `YYMMDD` UTC date. purpose.description: Accepted but ignored. Omit this field; it does not select the TED payment purpose.

name.description: Payee name. Decomposable Latin accents are removed; the result must contain only printable ASCII characters.

document_id.description: Payee document number, consistent with `document_type` and the receiving account holder.

bank_account.description: Payee account number, using digits only. Preserve leading zeros and omit spaces, punctuation and check-digit separators.

bank_account_type.description: Required account type: `1` CHECKING, `2` SALARY, `3` SAVINGS, `4` PAYMENT. Omission, `0` (UNSPECIFIED) and other types are rejected.

bank_name.description: Accepted but ignored. The payee bank is identified by `bank_code`.

merchant_order_id.description: Order ID supplied in the request.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID. Save it and use it as `txn_id` in [Get payment status](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-status).

txn_status.description: Submission status: `5` PROCESSING. This confirms asynchronous acceptance, not completion; query the original payment for its final outcome.

payee.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Retrieve participant information through [Get payment details](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-details).

payer.description: Not populated by this endpoint. Retrieve participant information through [Get payment details](/api-reference/payout/get-payment-details).

error.description: Null in the accepted response. Business errors use the root `code` and `message` fields with `data` set to null.

data.description: Present when `code` is `200`; null on errors.

status.description: Compliance status without the `COMPLIANCE_STATUS_` prefix. See [Read the compliance result](/api-reference/onboarding/kyb-callbacks#read-the-compliance-result) for each status. Approval alone does not prove that the account is ACTIVE.

result.description: Unused on a successful response. Read the outer `code`.

page.description: Pagination totals before visibility and tax-ID filtering.

settlement_txn_id.description: Settlement identifier of this payment or refund, when available.

merchant_order_id.description: Order identifier, when present. For refunds, it is omitted from the refund receiver callback.

txn_status.description: Transaction status as an enum name: pending, completed, failed, cancelled or processing. Delivery acknowledgement alone does not prove completion.

amount.description: Transaction amount as a decimal string in BRL.

payment_method.description: Payment rail as an enum name: Pix, card, TED, boleto or book transfer. An enum value does not imply the rail is enabled for your account.

payment_variant.description: Payment variant as an enum name. Each name identifies the Pix, QR, TED, book transfer or boleto variant.

flow_type.description: Transaction flow as an enum name: incoming, outgoing or transfer. Match the subscribed account against `payer` and `payee` for its role.

created_at.description: Initiation timestamp as a Unix-millisecond string. Omitted when unset.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp as a Unix-millisecond string. Omitted when unset.

refunded_amount.description: Recorded refunded amount as a decimal string, when present.

request_memo.description: QR description recovered for the payment, when available.

request_merchant_order_id.description: QR order identifier recovered for the payment, when available.

TransactionCallbacksRefund.description: Refund notification. The payer and payee are the refund parties.

delivery_id.description: Required in USER callbacks only. It identifies a subscription delivery and stays unchanged across retries. ACCOUNT callbacks omit it.

payer.description: Party sending this payment or refund.

payee.description: Party receiving this payment or refund.

flow_type.description: Transaction flow as an enum name: incoming, outgoing or transfer. Match the subscribed account against `payer` and `payee` for its role.

original_txn.description: Original payment associated with the refund.

TransactionCallbacksParty.description: Transaction party. Unset properties are omitted.

document_id.description: Taxpayer document. CPF can be masked according to the credential owner configuration.

document_type.description: Document type as an enum name: CPF or CNPJ.

bank_account_type.description: Account type as an enum name: checking, salary, savings, payment, transactional PI, guaranteed or deposit.

TransactionCallbacksOriginalTxn.description: Original payment details retained in a refund callback.

txn_id.description: Original payment identifier.

merchant_order_id.description: Original order identifier. For outgoing refunds, the QR order identifier replaces it when available; otherwise it can be omitted.

amount.description: Original payment amount as a decimal string in BRL.

debit_fee.description: Payer fee of the original payment, when populated, as a decimal string.

credit_fee.description: Receiver fee of the original payment, when populated, as a decimal string.

pix_key.description: Pix key associated with the payment.

pix_key_type.description: Pix key type as an enum name: `PIX_KEY_TYPE_CPF` for CPF, `PIX_KEY_TYPE_CNPJ` for CNPJ, and `PIX_KEY_TYPE_EMAIL` for email. `PIX_KEY_TYPE_PHONE` identifies phone keys; `PIX_KEY_TYPE_EVP` identifies random EVP keys.

qr_code_id.description: QR identifier associated with the payment, when available.

qr_code_memo.description: QR description recovered for this payment, when available.

event_type.description: Event type: `1` PIX_IN, `2` PIX_OUT, `3` REFUND_IN, `4` REFUND_OUT, `5` VA_ACCOUNT_KYB, `6` MASTER_ACCOUNT_KYB. ACCOUNT and USER credentials accept `1` through `5`; PLATFORM accepts only `6`. Omission or `0` is rejected.

callback_url.description: Omit to keep the current URL and callback signing credential. When provided, the trimmed value must be nonempty and replaces the URL; callbacks then use the credential signing this request.

status.description: Omit to keep the current status. `1` ACTIVE enables the subscription; `2` INACTIVE disables it. Explicit `0` is rejected, potentially after the URL has changed.

account_number.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; preserve leading zeros. Required for USER transaction events (`1` through `4`), but it does not limit the subscription to that account. Optional for ACCOUNT and must match its bound account when provided; omit it for USER event `5` and PLATFORM.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID, trimmed before lookup. When provided, selection uses the ID and authenticated owner, without additional application or event matching. When omitted, selection uses the owner, application and event; `event_type` and conditionally required `account_number` remain required.

webhook_id.description: Subscription ID to use as `subscription_id` in later requests.

event_type.description: Subscribed event name as a string. Request values `1` through `6` correspond to `PIX_PAYMENT_IN`, `PIX_PAYMENT_OUT`, `PIX_REFUND_IN`, `PIX_REFUND_OUT`, `VA_ACCOUNT_KYB` and `MASTER_ACCOUNT_KYB`. ID-based selection can return other event names.

status.description: Subscription status: `0` UNSPECIFIED, `1` ACTIVE, `2` INACTIVE. This describes the configuration, not callback delivery or transaction completion.

created_at.description: Original creation time in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Zero does not indicate pending creation.

updated_at.description: Last update time (UTC). Unix milliseconds at creation; after an update or deactivation, the stored value can be Unix seconds. Treat a nonzero value below `1000000000000` as seconds.

account_number.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Do not use it to determine the subscription scope.

subscription_id.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Use `webhook_id` as the subscription ID.

suspend_reason.description: Compatibility field returned as an empty string. Read `status` to check activation.

error.description: Current responses return `null`. Read the envelope's `code` and `message` for errors.

result.description: Current responses return `null`. Use the envelope's `code` to determine the result.

TransportError.description: The request never reached business logic: the body could not be read or is not valid JSON. The body is plain text, not the JSON envelope.
